findings.title: Client-removed listener calls V2 setPermissionsEnabled, which always throws
findings.body: The ClientRemovedEvent branch calls management(...).clients().setPermissionsEnabled(client, false). With ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 enabled, management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2, whose clients() now returns ClientPermissionsV2. Its setPermissionsEnabled unconditionally throws UnsupportedOperationException. Deleting any client in a realm under V2 can therefore fail or leave the realm in a half-deleted state.

findings.title: Listener gated on V1 feature flag, silently disabling cleanup for V2
findings.body: The whole listener body is now wrapped in Profile.isFeatureEnabled(ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ). Previously it ran unconditionally. Under V2 (where only ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 may be enabled), role, client and group removal no longer clean up permission state. This behavior change is unrelated to adding clients and is not explained in the PR.

findings.title: Possible NullPointerException when the 'all clients' resource is missing
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel, scope), if no per-client resource exists, the code loads the Clients type resource via getResourceTypeResource(). That method returns null when the schema is unsupported or the resource is not found. The result is passed straight to getPolicyStore().findByResource(server, resource) without a null check, which can throw an NPE instead of returning false.
